attempted_claim: Let D≥8 be a non-square discriminant with D≡0,1,4 (mod 8), and let ΩE_D(2,2)^odd be a connected component of the genus-three Prym eigenform locus. For unit-area (X,ω) in this locus, let N_cyl(X,R) count maximal cylinders whose core-curve circumference is at most R, counted once per cylinder. Determine the cylinder Siegel–Veech constant c_cyl(D): prove that N_cyl(X,R)∼c_cyl(D)R² as R→∞ for almost every (X,ω) with respect to the canonical SL_2(R)-invariant probability measure on the locus, and give an explicit formula for c_cyl(D), including the square-discriminant boundary case if the formula naturally extends.
decisive_failure: The investigation was limited to rigorous local deduction plus one consolidated literature call and a full-text read of the single strongest paper (Nguyen arXiv:2510.23333, 121 pages). No independent computation of cylinder-cusp volumes or cylinder-diagram statistics was possible within the bounded session, and the square-discriminant arithmetic case was likewise confirmed open rather than resolved.
